products.title: "Fletcher" Resin Figurine
products.body_html:
Cartner Series 1 release - 100% scale
10" tall
Made of resin, so it has great weight
Comes with signed certificate of authenticity 
Certificate numbered out of 50

"Fletcher" is the third release of The Cartner Series 1 release. The name derives from Jim Carrey's character in the movie Liar Liar. Fletcher Reede, a compulsive liar and fast-talking lawyer, who, due to his son Max's birthday wish, is magically unable to tell a lie for 24 hours. His inability to be dishonest during that 24 hours forces him to confront the consequences of his habitual lying and turn his life around. So Fletcher is a reflection of transparency in golf and how important it is to be upfront about your scores, especially when it comes to money games. Don't be that guy. Also at the end of the day, no one cares what you shot.

products.title: "Radge" Resin Figurine
products.body_html:
Cartner Series 1 release - 100% scale
10" tall
Made of resin, so it has great weight
Comes with signed certificate of authenticity 
Certificate numbered out of 35

The names “Radge” and “Barry” are actually old Scottish slang terms that were combined to make up the name Radry. Radge, meaning someone who is going crazy or not having a good time (the square in the logo), while Barry means something good or brilliant (the circle in the logo). Radry as a brand is all about mindset. It’s a mirror to life. Bad shots aren’t meant to be discouraging, but rather treated as an opportunity for growth. While good shots should be celebrated, no matter how small. Far too often are good shots glossed over during a bad stretch. Understanding that golf will always have its ebbs and flows (the mouth in the logo) and challenge you is its super power. It’s your approach to it that matters.

products.title: Joseph Camel Hat
products.body_html:
Details
• The fit is a cross between a low crown dad hat and standard higher crown. So it has a mid crown baseball hat style fit with a pre-curved bill. 
• Features a liner that stiffens the material to help hold the shape of the hat. Over time as the liner loosens, the hat will become familiar with your head shape and hold your perfect fit. 
• This is a heavier premium lifestyle hat, not a performance hat. This is your 'white cloth ravioli dinner' hat, not your 'skulling chips in the Texas heat' hat. 
• Corduroy fabric with embroidered artwork.
